profile.summary: Tanner Linsley is a senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Chart.js, specializing in core architecture, performance optimization, and data visualization algorithms. His contributions demonstrate mastery of class-based OOP, Canvas API manipulation, and modular design patterns. Tanner has led major refactors (e.g., animation system, controller-driven charts) and focuses on improving rendering efficiency, label placement, and API usability. His work aligns with senior-level responsibilities in maintaining and evolving a large-scale JavaScript library.
skill_evidence: "Controller Driven Charts" – Demonstrates class-based architecture and modular controller pattern for chart types
"Animation refactory" – Shows deep performance optimization using frame batching and animation lifecycle redesign
"Auto Rotate & Skip Labels based on 'scaleXMaxHeight'" – Involves Canvas API text rendering and collision detection
"Auto-skip crowded axis-labels" – Implements dynamic label placement using DOM/Canvas measurements
"Only draw positive radius arcs" – Fixes rendering logic with precise Canvas path manipulation
"External Tooltips, Documentation and Samples" – Adds new chart options and maintains documentation-driven API changes
"Try/Catch responsive resizing" – Includes error handling for event-driven responsive logic
"Deep data" – Refactors data structures to support reactive or type-safe configurations
